Title: The CARMENES search for exoplanets around M dwarfs. Cluster analysis of signals from spectral activity indicators to search for shared periods
Summary: Uses clustering to find shared periodicities among CARMENES spectral activity indicators to recover stellar rotation periods for M dwarfs.

Title: Precise radial velocities of giant stars -- XVII. Distinguishing planets from intrinsically induced radial velocity signals in evolved stars
Summary: Long-term radial-velocity monitoring of giant stars to distinguish true exoplanet signals from intrinsic stellar variability.

Title: Luminis Stellarum et Machina: Applications of Machine Learning in Light Curve Analysis
Summary: Survey of machine learning methods applied to light curve analysis for exoplanet, variable star, and supernova detection.

Title: Probing the Outskirts of M Dwarf Planetary Systems with a Cycle 1 JWST NIRCam Coronagraphy Survey
Summary: JWST NIRCam coronagraphy survey of young M dwarfs probing wide-orbit sub-Jupiter mass planets and debris disks.

Title: Radiative Flux from a High-Resolution Atmospheric Dynamics Simulation of a Hot-Jupiter for JWST and Ariel
Summary: Models radiative flux and variability of a hot Jupiter's atmosphere for JWST and Ariel observation planning.

Title: Planetary albedo is limited by the above-cloud atmosphere - Implications for sub-Neptune climate
Summary: Shows planetary albedo is capped by the above-cloud atmosphere, complicating claims of a habitable ocean on K2-18b.

Title: Unraveling the origin of giant exoplanets -- Observational implications of convective mixing
Summary: Simulates how convective mixing in giant planet atmospheres encodes information about their primordial formation state.

Title: Evidence for a polar circumbinary exoplanet orbiting a pair of eclipsing brown dwarfs
Summary: Reports strong evidence for a rare polar circumbinary exoplanet orbiting a pair of eclipsing brown dwarfs.

Title: New Constraints on DMS and DMDS in the Atmosphere of K2-18 b from JWST MIRI
Summary: New JWST MIRI mid-infrared spectrum of K2-18b provides independent evidence for the possible biosignature gases DMS/DMDS.

Title: Evolving Atmospheric Ion Escape from Kepler-1649 b and c: Power-Law Trends in Atmospheric Loss
Summary: Models long-term atmospheric ion escape from the two Kepler-1649 terrestrial planets under stellar wind and UV exposure.

Title: High-Time-Cadence Spectroscopy and Photometry of Stellar Flares on M-dwarf YZ Canis Minoris with Seimei Telescope and TESS. II. Statistical Properties of Blue/Red Asymmetries in the Halpha Line
Summary: Statistical study of blue/red H-alpha asymmetries from stellar flares on the M-dwarf YZ Canis Minoris.

Title: De-jittering Ariel - an optimized algorithm
Summary: Describes an improved algorithm to remove spacecraft-jitter noise from simulated Ariel exoplanet transit observations.

Title: Prospects for Detecting Signs of Life on Exoplanets in the JWST Era
Summary: Reflects on JWST's early results and challenges in the search for biosignature gases on exoplanets.

Title: Exoplaneteers Keep Calling Plots Allan Variance Plots When They Arent
Summary: Commentary noting that many exoplanet papers mislabel a standard-deviation-vs-bin-size plot as an 'Allan variance' plot.

Title: Quantifying the Limits of TESS Stellar Rotation Measurements with the K2-TESS Overlap
Summary: Cross-matches TESS and K2 stellar rotation periods to quantify the reliability limits of TESS-derived rotation measurements.

Title: A Revised Density Estimate for the Largest Known Exoplanet, HAT-P-67 b
Summary: Revises the mass and density of the puffy hot Saturn HAT-P-67 b, finding it is losing its atmosphere and will be engulfed.

Title: Refractory phosphorus in the HD 100546 protoplanetary disk
Summary: Measures the phosphorus budget in the HD 100546 protoplanetary disk to constrain planetary habitability chemistry.

Title: Upper limits on CN from exocomets transiting beta Pictoris
Summary: Searches HARPS spectra of exocomets transiting Beta Pictoris for cyanogen gas, reporting only an upper limit.

Title: Stringent Limits on H3+ Emission from the Hot Jupiters WASP-80b and WASP-69b
Summary: Keck spectroscopy sets stringent non-detection limits on infrared auroral H3+ emission from two hot Jupiters.

Title: Plasma Mechanism of Radio Emission Generation at the Bow Shock of the Exoplanet HD 189733b
Summary: Models a plasma mechanism by which the bow shock of hot Jupiter HD 189733b could generate detectable radio emission.

Title: Identifying eclipsing binary stars with TESS data based on a new hybrid deep learning model
Summary: Hybrid deep-learning model (CALNet) identifies thousands of new eclipsing binary stars in TESS light curves.

Title: Are there Spectral Features in the MIRI-LRS Transmission Spectrum of K2-18b
Summary: Re-analysis finds no strong statistical evidence for the claimed spectral features in K2-18b's MIRI transmission spectrum.

Title: Uncertainties in the Inference of Internal Structure - The Case of TRAPPIST-1 f
Summary: Quantifies how model assumptions versus observational precision drive uncertainty in TRAPPIST-1 f's inferred water content.

Title: Gas-phase formation routes of dimethyl sulfide in the interstellar medium
Summary: Quantum/kinetics calculations identify abiotic gas-phase routes that form dimethyl sulfide in interstellar molecular clouds.

Title: MHD Simulations Preliminarily Predict The Habitability and Radio Emission of TRAPPIST-1e
Summary: MHD simulations predict how space weather shapes the habitability and radio emission of TRAPPIST-1e's magnetosphere.

Title: Thermal Evolution and Mass Loss on Short-Period, Low-Mass Planets During FU Orionis Outbursts
Summary: Models how FU Orionis stellar outbursts can vaporize and strip mass from short-period low-mass planets.

Title: Thermal Emission and Confirmation of the Frigid White Dwarf Exoplanet WD 1856+534b
Summary: JWST MIRI detects thermal emission confirming WD 1856+534b as a cold, intact planet orbiting a white dwarf.

Title: Towards understanding stellar variability at the sub m-s level - Isolating granulation signals in synthetic spectral lines
Summary: Uses 3D simulations to isolate stellar granulation signals from spectral lines to reduce noise in exoplanet radial-velocity searches.

Title: The tidal heating of the exoplanet 55 Cnc e - The role of the orbital eccentricity
Summary: Tidal heating models suggest an unseen resonant planet may explain 55 Cancri e's nonzero orbital eccentricity.

Title: Ice Giants
Summary: Review of current knowledge on the interior structure, magnetic fields, and formation of Uranus and Neptune.

Title: A transiting rocky super-Earth and a non-transiting sub-Neptune orbiting the M dwarf TOI-771
Summary: Characterizes a rocky super-Earth and non-transiting sub-Neptune orbiting the M dwarf TOI-771 using TESS and ESPRESSO data.

Title: Life on the Edge - Using Planetary Context to Enhance Biosignatures and Avoid False Positives
Summary: Proposes 'peribiosignatures' and argues searching the edges of the habitable zone may better validate biosignature claims.

Title: Validation of the ESPRESSO Wavelength Calibration Using Iodine Absorption Cell Spectra
Summary: Uses an iodine absorption cell to validate ESPRESSO's radial-velocity wavelength calibration at the few-cm/s level.

Title: Peeking under the clouds - Is exoplanet imaging with the solar gravitational lens feasible
Summary: Finds that variable cloud cover would substantially degrade exoplanet images obtained via the solar gravitational lens.

Title: A Search for Exoplanet Candidates in TESS 2-min Light Curves using Joint Bayesian Detection
Summary: Applies a joint Bayesian transit detector to TESS light curves, recovering known planets and searching for new candidates.

Title: A Next-Generation Exoplanet Atmospheric Retrieval Framework for Transmission Spectroscopy (NEXOTRANS) - Comparative Characterization for WASP-39 b Using JWST NIRISS, NIRSpec PRISM, and MIRI Observations
Summary: Introduces NEXOTRANS, a hybrid Bayesian/machine-learning retrieval framework, to characterize WASP-39 b's JWST transmission spectrum.

Title: SHINS, the SHARK-NIR Instrument Control Software
Summary: Describes SHINS, the control software for the SHARK-NIR high-contrast direct-imaging instrument at the LBT.

Title: The Cosmic Shoreline Revisited - A Metric for Atmospheric Retention Informed by Hydrodynamic Escape
Summary: Revisits the 'cosmic shoreline' relation using hydrodynamic escape models to predict which rocky exoplanets retain atmospheres.

Title: Lightning activity on a tidally locked terrestrial exoplanet in storm-resolving simulations for a range of surface pressures
Summary: Storm-resolving climate simulations predict lightning frequency and distribution on a tidally locked terrestrial exoplanet.

Title: Microlensing events indicate that super-Earth exoplanets are common in Jupiter-like orbits
Summary: Microlensing survey finds super-Earths on Jupiter-like wide orbits are common, roughly 0.35 per star.

Title: Planets Across Space and Time (PAST). VI. Age Dependence of the Occurrence and Architecture of Ultra-Short-Period Planet Systems
Summary: Finds ultra-short-period planet occurrence and system architecture evolve over Gyr timescales via tidal migration.

Title: Ground to Dust - Collisional Cascades and the Fate of Kardashev II Megaswarms
Summary: Shows that Dyson-swarm-like 'megaswarms' around stars are prone to rapid collisional cascades, making them short-lived technosignatures without upkeep.

Title: Biases from Missing a Small Planet in High Multiplicity Systems
Summary: Shows that failing to detect one planet in a multi-planet system biases inferred spacing regularity, not mass similarity.

Title: The Challenges of Detecting Gases in Exoplanet Atmospheres
Summary: Shows claimed biosignature gas detections in K2-18b's spectrum vanish once a wider space of atmospheric models is tested.

Title: Polka-dotted Stars - a Hierarchical Model for Mapping Stellar Surfaces Using Occultation Light Curves and the Case of TOI-3884
Summary: New Bayesian framework maps starspot properties on TOI-3884 using spot-crossing events during planetary transits.

Title: Quantifying the Fermi paradox via passive SETI - a general framework
Summary: Builds a geometrical/Drake-equation framework to quantify the Fermi paradox from the probability of detecting at least one extraterrestrial EM signal via passive SETI.

Title: Quantum-inspired exoplanet detection in the presence of experimental imperfections
Summary: Analyzes quantum-optimal spatial demultiplexing (SPADE) for exoplanet detection under realistic noise, finding it remains the most efficient method in the sub-Rayleigh regime.

Title: Can Close-In Exoplanets form by Pebble Accretion
Summary: Models how pebble accretion parameters (turbulence, metallicity, stellar mass) influence the growth of close-in exoplanets within 1 au.

Title: Reconstructing the Free-floating Planet Mass Function with the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
Summary: Studies the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope's ability to reconstruct the mass function of free-floating planets via population-level statistical inference.

Title: Instrumentation prospects for rocky exoplanet atmospheres studies with high resolution spectroscopy
Summary: Reviews ground-based high-resolution spectroscopy instrumentation prospects for detecting biosignature gases like O2 in rocky exoplanet atmospheres.

Title: Benchmark stars for mean stellar density and surface gravity estimates of solar-type stars
Summary: Compiles benchmark solar-type stars with precise mean stellar density and surface gravity measurements to calibrate exoplanet radius estimates.

Title: Bridging the Atmospheric Circulations of Hot and Warm Giant Exoplanets
Summary: Compares high-resolution atmospheric circulation simulations of tidally-locked hot and warm giant exoplanets KELT-11b and WASP-39b.

Title: Seismic Oscillations Excited by Giant Impacts in Directly-Imaged Giant Planets
Summary: Shows giant impacts on young directly-imaged giant planets excite long-lived seismic oscillations detectable via photometry, illustrated with Beta Pictoris b.

Title: Comparative Biosignatures
Summary: Proposes a comparative multi-planet approach to define an 'abiotic baseline' for identifying genuine biosignatures across planets in the same system.

Title: From Tides to Currents - Unraveling the Mechanism That Powers WASP-107b's Internal Heat Flux
Summary: Proposes Ohmic dissipation from atmospheric zonal flows and magnetic fields, rather than tidal heating alone, as the source of WASP-107b's internal heat flux.

Title: Closeby Habitable Exoplanet Survey (CHES). IV. Synergy between astrometry and direct imaging missions of the Habitable World Observatory for detecting Earth-like planets
Summary: Evaluates synergy between CHES astrometry and Habitable Worlds Observatory direct imaging for improving detection of Earth-like planets.

Title: Self-limited tidal heating and prolonged magma oceans in the L 98-59 system
Summary: Models self-limiting tidal heating and prolonged magma oceans in the L 98-59 rocky exoplanet system via a radiation-tide-rheology feedback.

Title: Discovery of resonating integration modes in triple-mode high-amplitude delta Scuti stars - A new evolutionary phase indicator
Summary: Reports discovery of resonating integration modes in triple-mode high-amplitude delta Scuti stars as a new stellar evolutionary phase indicator.

Title: Statistical geochemical constraints on present-day water outgassing as a source of secondary atmospheres on the TRAPPIST-1 exoplanets
Summary: Uses geochemical modeling to constrain present-day water outgassing rates as a source of secondary atmospheres on the TRAPPIST-1 planets.

Title: Young Planets around Young Accreting Stars - I. Migration and Inner Stalling Orbits
Summary: Simulates migration mechanisms of young planets in turbulent MHD protoplanetary disks, finding many planets stall near the magnetospheric truncation radius.

Title: Effects of transient stellar emissions on planetary climates of tidally-locked exo-earths
Summary: Uses 3D climate models with interactive photochemistry to simulate how stellar flares and energetic particles affect the atmosphere and climate of tidally-locked TRAPPIST-1e-like exoplanets.

Title: Minimizing Star Spot Contamination of Exoplanet Transit Spectroscopy Using Alternate Normalization
Summary: Develops an alternate spectral normalization method to reduce star-spot contamination noise in transit spectroscopy searches for biosignature molecules around M-dwarfs.

Title: Using anomaly detection to search for technosignatures in Breakthrough Listen observations
Summary: Applies machine learning anomaly detection to Breakthrough Listen radio observations of hundreds of stars, visually inspecting ~20,000 top candidates with no technosignature surviving scrutiny.

Title: The Eccentricity Distribution of Warm Sub-Saturns in TESS
Summary: Derives the eccentricity distribution of warm sub-Saturn exoplanets from TESS transit light curves, finding a population of highly eccentric planets suggestive of high-eccentricity migration.

Title: A Detailed Investigation of HD 209458 b HST and JWST Transmission Spectra with SANSAR
Summary: Uses the new SANSAR retrieval framework to reanalyze HD 209458 b's HST and JWST transmission spectra, finding combined optical-to-infrared data needed for robust metallicity constraints.

Title: No Planet around the K Giant Star 42 Draconis
Summary: Uses 15 years of radial velocity and photometric monitoring to conclusively rule out a previously claimed giant planet around the K giant star 42 Draconis, attributing signals to stellar oscillations.

Title: Effects of Jump Detection and Ramp Fitting Algorithms on NIRISS-SOSS Exoplanet Time-Series Observations
Summary: Compares JWST data reduction algorithms for jump detection and ramp fitting, finding a new likelihood-based method improves NIRISS/SOSS exoplanet transmission spectra accuracy.

Title: Peekaboo - Secular Resonances from Evolving Stellar Oblateness Impede Transit Detection
Summary: Shows sweeping secular resonances from evolving stellar oblateness can misalign inner planets, reducing the observed rate of multi-planet transiting systems like Kepler-619.

Title: Search for Exoplanetary Ring Systems with TESS
Summary: Systematically searches 308 TESS giant planet candidates for exoplanetary ring systems, finding no conclusive detections and setting upper limits on ring occurrence rates.

Title: Metal-Enriched Atmospheres in Warm (Super- and Sub-)Neptunes Induced by Extreme Atmospheric Escape
Summary: Models how billions of years of atmospheric escape enrich metal abundances in warm super/sub-Neptune atmospheres, complicating interpretation of their formation history from observed compositions.

Title: A Machine-Learning Compositional Study of Exoplanetary Material Accreted Onto Five Helium-Atmosphere White Dwarfs with cecilia
Summary: Applies a new machine learning pipeline to determine the composition of exoplanetary material accreted onto five helium-atmosphere white dwarfs, finding compositions broadly consistent with chondritic material.

Title: TESS Investigation -- Demographics of Young Exoplanets (TI-DYE) III - an inner super-Earth in TOI-2076
Summary: Reports discovery of a small inner super-Earth in the young multi-planet TOI-2076 system and updates the system's age using rotation and lithium diagnostics.

Title: Hydrogen-rich hydrate at high pressures up to 104 GPa
Summary: Uses X-ray diffraction and Raman spectroscopy to identify a new hydrogen-rich hydrate phase at pressures up to 104 GPa, relevant to the interiors of icy giant planets.

Title: WISE 12 micron search for exozodi candidates within 10 parsecs
Summary: Searches WISE 12-micron photometry for exozodiacal dust around stars within 10 parsecs, finding candidate excesses are more likely brown dwarf photosphere effects than true exozodi.

Title: Clouds can enhance direct imaging detection of O2 and O3 on terrestrial exoplanets
Summary: Uses simulated direct-imaging observations to show clouds generally enhance the detectability of O2 and O3 biosignatures on terrestrial exoplanets, aiding future HWO observations.

Title: Three-dimensional Orbit and Dynamical Masses of GJ 105 AC
Summary: Presents an updated orbital analysis and precise dynamical masses for the benchmark binary star system GJ 105 AC.

Title: viper - High-precision radial velocities from the optical to the infrared
Summary: Introduces viper, a radial-velocity pipeline achieving high precision from optical to infrared wavelengths via telluric modelling, demonstrated with CRIRES+.

Title: GRIP - a generic data reduction package for nulling interferometry
Summary: Introduces GRIP, an open-source data reduction toolbox for nulling interferometry used to detect exoplanets and circumstellar dust.

Title: CHEOPS Ground Segment - Systems and Automation for Mission and Science Operations
Summary: Describes the CHEOPS mission's ground segment systems and automation framework for exoplanet-focused photometric operations.

Title: Water ice in the debris disk around HD 181327
Summary: Reports JWST detection of water ice in the HD 181327 debris disk, revealing an exo-Kuiper belt analog to our solar system's icy bodies.

Title: The atmospheres of rocky exoplanets III. Using atmospheric spectra to constrain surface rock composition
Summary: Links observable atmospheric transit spectra to the mineralogical surface composition of rocky exoplanets using equilibrium chemistry models.

Title: Exoplanet atmospheres at high spectral resolution
Summary: Reviews high-resolution spectroscopy techniques and findings for characterizing exoplanet atmospheres, from chemistry to atmospheric escape.

Title: NeurIPS 2024 Ariel Data Challenge - Characterisation of Exoplanetary Atmospheres Using a Data-Centric Approach
Summary: Describes a data-centric machine learning approach for the NeurIPS 2024 Ariel Data Challenge on exoplanet atmosphere characterization.

Title: Searching for GEMS - Confirmation of TOI-5573b, a Cool, Saturn-like Planet Orbiting An M-dwarf
Summary: Confirms TOI-5573b, a cool Saturn-like exoplanet orbiting an M-dwarf, using TESS photometry and radial velocity data.

Title: Architecture of Tianyu Software - Relative Photometry as a Case Study
Summary: Describes the software architecture of the Tianyu telescope pipeline, demonstrating scalable relative photometry for detecting transiting exoplanets and variable stars.

Title: TASSIE - a TASmanian Search for Inclined Exoplanets
Summary: Presents pilot results from the TASSIE program validating five TESS exoplanet candidates using photometry and spectroscopy from a Tasmanian observatory.

Title: An Analytical Model of Wavelength-dependent Opposition Surge in Emittance and Reflectance Spectroscopy of Airless Rocky Exoplanets
Summary: Proposes an analytical model for wavelength-dependent opposition surge effects in reflectance/emittance spectroscopy of airless rocky exoplanets.

Title: The vertical structure of debris discs and the role of disc gravity
Summary: Models how disc self-gravity affects the vertical structure and warping of debris discs perturbed by an inclined planet.

Title: Diversity of Exoplanets
Summary: Reviews the observed compositional diversity of low-mass exoplanets (super-Earths, mini-Neptunes) and what it reveals about planet formation.

Title: Open Source High-Resolution Exoplanet Atmosphere Retrievals with POSEIDON
Summary: Presents POSEIDON, an open-source framework for high-resolution exoplanet atmosphere retrievals, validated on WASP-77Ab and WASP-121b.

Title: The Hot-Neptune Initiative (HONEI) I. Two hot sub-Neptunes on a close-in, eccentric orbit (TOI-5800 b) and a farther-out, circular orbit (TOI-5817 b)
Summary: Confirms two hot sub-Neptune exoplanets, TOI-5800b and TOI-5817b, via radial velocity follow-up as part of the HONEI program.

Title: Non-transiting exoplanets as a means to understand star-planet interactions in close-in systems
Summary: Searches Kepler data for close-in non-transiting substellar companions, identifying 88 candidate systems useful for studying star-planet tidal/magnetic interactions.

Title: Retrieving interior properties of hot Jupiters with Love numbers and atmospheric measurements
Summary: Develops a retrieval framework using Love numbers and atmospheric metallicity to constrain the interior structure and core mass of hot Jupiters.

Title: A Systematic Search for Trace Molecules in Exoplanet K2-18 b
Summary: Conducts an agnostic search across 650 molecules in K2-18 b's JWST spectrum, finding weak evidence for a few biogenic gases beyond the previously reported DMS.

Title: Roman Observations Time Allocation Committee - Final Report and Recommendations
Summary: Reports the Roman Observations Time Allocation Committee's final recommendations for the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope's core community surveys.

Title: Exoplanet Detection with Microlensing
Summary: Reviews the microlensing method for detecting wide-orbit, solar-system-analog exoplanets, highlighting the upcoming Roman Space Telescope's role.

Title: Interior and Climate Modeling of the Venus Zone Planet TOI-2285 b
Summary: Models the interior and climate of Venus Zone planet TOI-2285 b, finding temperate scenarios consistent with its known properties despite a likely steam atmosphere.

Title: Cloudy mornings and clear evenings on a giant extrasolar world
Summary: Reports detection of limb asymmetry in WASP-94A b's atmosphere, with clouds on the cooler morning limb and clear skies on the hotter evening limb.

Title: High-resolution, high-efficiency narrowband spectroscopy with an s-p-phased holographic grating in double pass
Summary: Demonstrates a high-throughput holographic grating design for high-resolution narrowband spectroscopy, relevant to exoplanet radial velocity and atmospheric instruments.

Title: Absence of a Runaway Greenhouse Limit on Lava Planets
Summary: Shows multi-component outgassed atmospheres on lava planets lack the runaway greenhouse thermal limit seen in pure-steam models, challenging the classical habitable zone definition.

Title: Modelling helium in exoplanet atmospheres. A revised network with photoelectron-driven processes
Summary: Revises the chemical network modeling helium absorption in exoplanet atmospheres to include photoelectron-driven processes, applied to GJ 436 b.

Title: Inclusion of sulfur chemistry in a validated C-H-O-N chemical network - identification of key C-S coupling pathways
Summary: Develops a validated sulfur-inclusive C/H/O/N chemical network to model photochemistry and abundance profiles in exoplanet atmospheres like WASP-39b and WASP-107b.

Title: gr8stars I - A homogeneous spectroscopic study of bright FGKM dwarfs and a public library of their high-resolution spectra
Summary: Presents gr8stars, a homogeneous spectroscopic survey and public spectral library of bright FGKM dwarf stars relevant to exoplanet host characterization.

Title: A planetary-mass candidate imaged in the Young Suns Exoplanet Survey
Summary: Reports a directly imaged planetary-mass candidate companion at a very wide separation (730 au) discovered by the Young Suns Exoplanet Survey.

Title: A Panchromatic Characterization of the Evening and Morning Atmosphere of WASP-107 b - Composition and Cloud Variations, and Insight into the Effect of Stellar Contamination
Summary: Characterizes evening/morning limb composition and cloud variation on WASP-107 b using JWST, and models stellar contamination effects on the measurements.

Title: Effects of Ultraviolet Radiation on Sub-Neptune Exoplanet Hazes Through Laboratory Experiments
Summary: Presents lab experiments showing UV radiation from stellar flares alters and degrades photochemical hazes on sub-Neptune exoplanets.

Title: Can thermodynamic equilibrium be established in planet-forming disks
Summary: Develops a new chemical network (ChaiTea) to test whether thermodynamic equilibrium can be established in the warm, dense inner regions of planet-forming disks.

Title: CORALIE radial-velocity search for companions around evolved stars (CASCADES) IV - New planetary systems around HD 87816, HD 94890, and HD 102888 and an update on HD 121056
Summary: Reports discovery of five new massive exoplanets around evolved giant stars HD 87816, HD 94890, and HD 102888 via CORALIE radial-velocity monitoring.

Title: Modern Earth-like Chemical Disequilibrium Biosignatures Are Challenging To Constrain Through Spectroscopic Retrievals
Summary: Uses atmospheric retrievals to assess how detectable chemical disequilibrium biosignatures (available Gibbs free energy) are for a modern Earth-like exoplanet analog.

Title: Abiotic Ozone in the Observable Atmospheres of Venus and Venus-like Exoplanets
Summary: Uses photochemical modeling to show Venus's abiotic mesospheric ozone arises from an unknown chemical pathway, warning of ozone biosignature false positives on Venus-like exoplanets.

Title: Is Ozone a Reliable Proxy for Molecular Oxygen II. The impact of N2O on the O2-O3 relationship for Earth-like atmospheres
Summary: Models how nitrous oxide abundance affects the O2-O3 relationship across different host star types, complicating the use of ozone as an oxygen biosignature proxy.

Title: An Exploratory Framework for Future SETI Applications - Detecting Generative Reactivity via Language Models
Summary: Proposes using language models to detect 'generative reactivity' in noise-like signals (e.g., whale/bird vocalizations) as a novel complementary SETI signal-screening method.

Title: The Diversity of Exoplanetary Environments and the Search for Signs of Life Beyond Earth
Summary: Reviews the diversity of exoplanetary environments where life could plausibly exist, including alternative solvents, cloud biospheres, and metal-ion requirements for biochemistry.

Title: Breakthrough Listen - A Technosignature Search Around 27 Eclipsing Exoplanets Selected from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite Catalogue
Summary: Reports a Breakthrough Listen radio technosignature search around 27 eclipsing TESS exoplanets using Parkes telescope data, finding no signals beyond terrestrial RFI.

Title: Application of a modified commercial laser mass spectrometer as a science analog of the Mars Organic Molecule Analyzer (MOMA)
Summary: Presents a benchtop laser mass spectrometer analog of the Mars MOMA instrument for validating organic biosignature detection ahead of the Rosalind Franklin rover mission.

Title: SETI@home - Data Acquisition and Front-End Processing
Summary: Describes SETI@home's distributed-computing front-end data acquisition and processing pipeline for radio technosignature searches at Arecibo Observatory (1998-2020).

Title: SETI@home - Data Analysis and Findings
Summary: Describes SETI@home's second-stage analysis of 14 years of Arecibo radio data, covering RFI removal and ranking of technosignature candidates for follow-up with FAST.

Title: Technosignature Searches with Real-time Alert Brokers
Summary: Explores using real-time astronomical alert brokers (ZTF, upcoming LSST) to conduct optical and temporal SETI searches, including planetary transit zone and SETI Ellipsoid methods.

Title: Possibilities for SETI at High Energy
Summary: White paper reviewing the rationale, challenges, and possible technosignatures for high-energy SETI searches in X-rays, gamma rays, and neutrinos.

Title: Detecting Land with Reflected Light Spectroscopy to Rule Out Waterworld O2 Biosignature False Positives
Summary: Shows reflected-light spectroscopy with the Habitable Worlds Observatory could detect exposed land on exo-Earths, ruling out waterworld O2 biosignature false positives.

Title: Detecting Land with Reflected Light Spectroscopy to Rule Out Waterworld O2 Biosignature False Positives
Summary: Shows reflected-light spectroscopy with the Habitable Worlds Observatory could detect exposed land on exo-Earths, ruling out waterworld O2 biosignature false positives.

Title: Prebiosignatures with the Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO)
Summary: Proposes searching for 'prebiosignature gases' with the Habitable Worlds Observatory to test theories of abiogenesis even where detectable life is rare.

Title: Sub-Neptunes Are Drier Than They Seem - Rethinking the Origins of Water-Rich Worlds
Summary: Models chemical equilibration between primordial atmospheres and magma oceans, showing most sub-Neptunes lose their accreted water and don't qualify as Hycean planets.

Title: Detecting alien living worlds and photosynthetic life using imaging polarimetry with the HWO coronagraph
Summary: Proposes HWO coronagraph imaging polarimetry surveys to detect photosynthetic biosignatures via linear/circular polarization signatures of biopigments on exoplanets.

Title: Detecting alien living worlds and photosynthetic life using imaging polarimetry with the HWO coronagraph
Summary: Proposes HWO coronagraph imaging polarimetry surveys to detect photosynthetic biosignatures via linear/circular polarization signatures of biopigments on exoplanets.

Title: SETI Post-Detection Futures - Directions for Technosignature Research and Readiness
Summary: White paper on SETI post-detection readiness, recommending NASA investment in interdisciplinary infrastructure for handling a potential technosignature detection.

Title: A water-rich interior in the temperate sub-Neptune K2-18 b revealed by JWST
Summary: Uses new JWST/NIRSpec transit spectra of K2-18 b to robustly detect CH4 and CO2, establishing a water-rich interior while finding only marginal DMS/CH3SH signals.

Title: Wavelength Requirements for Life Detection via Reflected Light Spectroscopy of Rocky Exoplanets
Summary: Determines the near-UV to near-infrared wavelength coverage HWO needs to contextualize O2/CH4 biosignatures and rule out false positives on rocky exoplanets.

Title: From Extraterrestrial Microbes to Alien Intelligence - Rebalancing Astronomical Research Priorities
Summary: Argues for rebalancing NASA funding toward extraterrestrial intelligence/technosignature research, citing the funding gap relative to biosignature missions like HWO.

Title: NASA Exoplanet Exploration Program (ExEP) Science Gap List
Summary: Lists NASA's Exoplanet Exploration Program annual science gaps needed to advance future exoplanet characterization and biosignature missions.

Title: Towards the Habitable Worlds Observatory - 1D CNN Retrieval of Reflection Spectra from Evolving Earth Analogs
Summary: Trains a 1D CNN to retrieve molecular abundances and biosignatures from simulated reflection spectra of evolving Earth-like exoplanets for future HWO observations.

Title: Artificial Broadcasts as Galactic Populations III. Constraints on Radio Broadcasts from the Cosmic Population of Inhabited Galaxies
Summary: Uses radio source count and SETI survey field limits to constrain the abundance of artificial radio broadcast populations from inhabited galaxies, including Kardashev Type III limits.

Title: Unveiling the Atmosphere of HR 7672 B from the Near-Infrared High-Resolution Spectrum Using REACH-Subaru
Summary: Reports a near-infrared high-resolution atmospheric retrieval of brown dwarf HR 7672 B using the REACH/Subaru instrument, identifying H2O, FeH, and cloud opacity.

Title: Testing Gamma-Hadron Separation for Ultra-High-Energy Cherenkov Astronomy
Summary: Presents gamma/hadron separation simulations for the Dark100/PANOSETI Cherenkov telescope array, part of an optical/high-energy SETI-linked instrument used for dark matter and transient searches.

Title: 21st-Century Astrobiology Missions Should Seek These High-Confidence Biosignatures in Mid-Latitude Martian Ice
Summary: White paper identifying high-confidence agnostic biosignature targets (biopolymers, homochirality, chiral metabolism) for future astrobiology missions to Martian mid-latitude ice.

Title: Development of PANOSETI Telescopes for Ultra-High-Energy Gamma-Ray Astronomy
Summary: Describes development and deployment of PANOSETI's Fresnel-lens optical/UHE gamma-ray telescopes, part of the Dark100 array combining SETI and astroparticle science.

Title: K2-18b Does Not Meet The Standards of Evidence For Life
Summary: Reanalyzes JWST data of K2-18b using independent methods, finding MIRI instrumental systematics undermine the reported DMS/DMDS biosignature evidence.

Title: A 2821 Star Optical SETI Survey using ESO HARPS archival data
Summary: Conducts an optical SETI survey of 2,821 stars using archival HARPS spectra, narrowing thousands of laser-like spectral spikes down to 3 unexplained candidates warranting follow-up.

Title: White Paper on Phototrophic Biosignatures - Research Priorities for the Search for Life on Other Worlds
Summary: White paper identifying research priorities for phototrophic biosignatures, including diverse light-harvesting pigments and photosynthesis pathways detectable via direct imaging missions.

Title: Archival Diagnostics for Potential Background Contaminants of Project Hephaistos Dyson Sphere Candidates
Summary: Uses archival Gaia, WISE, and optical/near-IR imaging to identify background contamination in Project Hephaistos Dyson Sphere candidate M-dwarfs, ruling out several as false positives.

Title: A search for narrowband technosignatures from LTT 3780 with the Allen Telescope Array and the Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array
Summary: Reports a combined ATA and VLA radio technosignature search of the LTT3780 exoplanet system, including candidate Hycean world LTT3780c, finding no candidate signals.

Title: SETI's blind spot - Technological Acceleration and fleeting technosignatures
Summary: Models how technological acceleration shrinks the window during which a civilization's technosignatures overlap with our detection capability, advocating broadband, technology-agnostic search strategies.

Title: Decolonizing technosignatures - Reimagining technosignatures through an Indigenist lens
Summary: Argues technosignature searches implicitly search for 'polluting' civilizations reflecting Earth's colonial societies, and proposes reconsidering technosignatures through an Indigenous studies lens.

Title: Stellar J-Harvesting - a novel angular momentum technosignature and first search in the Kepler field
Summary: Introduces Stellar J-Harvesting, a technosignature where an engineered system extracts a star's rotational angular momentum, and conducts a pilot slow-rotator search in Kepler field stars.

Title: Probing the origins. III. Exoplanet demographics across Galactic birth radii
Summary: Uses Gaia astrometry and Galactic chemical evolution models to trace exoplanet host stars' birth radii and radial migration, identifying reference populations for future habitability searches.

Title: Cradle of Life - From the Formation of Stars to Habitable Worlds with the SKAO
Summary: Overviews the SKAO 'Cradle of Life' science cases spanning star/planet formation, exoplanet auroral radio emission, and systematic technosignature searches across the SKA's frequency range.

Title: Detecting habitable exoplanet atmospheres with LIFE, the Large Interferometer for Exoplanets
Summary: White paper arguing the LIFE mid-infrared interferometer can detect a wider range of biosignatures at lower concentrations than HWO, including methane as a key false-positive discriminator.

Title: Spaceflight from Super-Earths is difficult
Summary: Shows that chemical rockets can still achieve escape velocity from rocky Super-Earths up to 10 Earth masses, beyond which nuclear propulsion would be required for spaceflight.

Title: Breakthrough Listen's Automated Commensal Technosignature Survey with MeerKAT
Summary: Describes BLUSE, Breakthrough Listen's autonomous commensal technosignature survey system on the MeerKAT array, which has processed over 1.2 million pointings since 2022.

Title: Modelling Radio Frequency Interference on the Lunar Farside
Summary: Models how growing lunar satellite traffic will increasingly contaminate the radio-quiet lunar farside environment needed for future technosignature and transient searches like LFT3.

Title: Project Hephaistos -- III. Characterizing anomalous infrared sources identified as Dyson-sphere candidates
Summary: Follows up seven Project Hephaistos Dyson-sphere candidate M-dwarfs with new photometry/spectroscopy, finding no clear explanation for their infrared excess but noting some may be background contamination.

Title: The Lunar Farside Transients and Technology Telescope (LFT3) Mission
Summary: Describes the proposed LFT3 lunar farside radio telescope mission, designed to exploit the interference-free environment for technosignature searches, transients, and other radio science.

Title: Characterizing the oxidation state of rocky exoplanets with the Large Interferometer for Exoplanets (LIFE)
Summary: Uses the LIFE mid-infrared interferometer simulator to show how retrieved atmospheric CO2/CH4/NH3 can distinguish the oxidation state of rocky exoplanet mantles.

Title: Early Exploration of the Scientific Discovery Space for the Habitable Worlds Observatory
Summary: Presents 70 HWO science cases developed by NASA's START working groups spanning galaxy evolution, elemental chemistry, solar system science, and living worlds.

Title: The Ĝ Infrared Search for Extraterrestrial Civilizations with Large Energy Supplies. V. When Galaxies Glow with Industry
Summary: Applies stellar population synthesis modeling to 129 nearby galaxies searching for galaxy-spanning Dyson sphere waste heat, finding no detections and setting population-level upper limits.

Title: Gaia DR3 Limits on Stellar Engine Technosignatures in Nearby Stars
Summary: Searches Gaia DR3 astrometric accelerations of 406,984 nearby stars for signatures of operating stellar engines, finding no candidates and setting population upper limits.

Title: The VLA and High-Frequency SETI: Expanding the Search for Life
Summary: Describes the COSMIC system's high-frequency radio technosignature search on the VLA, using Doppler drift detection on Gaia-catalogued exoplanet host stars.

Title: The Effects of M Star Age Dependent Ultraviolet Emission on Detecting and Interpreting Exoplanet Biosignatures
Summary: Models how M-dwarf age-dependent UV flux alters photochemistry and biosignature gas abundances (CH4, O3) in Pre-Industrial and Archean Earth-like atmospheres, risking misinterpretation of ozone features.

Title: RISTRETTO: Assembly and Testing of the Seven-spaxel, High-resolution, Diffraction-limited Spectrograph
Summary: Reports on the assembly, lab testing, and first on-sky testing of the RISTRETTO seven-spaxel high-resolution spectrograph built for direct detection of reflected exoplanet light and biosignatures.

Title: Deep Learning-Based Coarse Alignment and Cophasing of a Distributed-Aperture Telescope. Application to the Small ExoLife Finder (SELF)
Summary: Develops a CNN-based deep learning method to estimate and correct alignment errors in the Small ExoLife Finder prototype, a testbed for the future biosignature-hunting ExoLife Finder interferometric telescope.

Title: On the Impact of Correlated Noise and Spectral Resolution on the Retrieval Analysis of the Habitable World Observatory
Summary: Simulates HWO atmospheric retrievals to show correlated noise degrades biosignature (H2O, O2) abundance accuracy at low spectral resolution (R=140), and finds that raising resolution to R=1000 or pairing HWO with the LIFE mission substantially improves retrieval accuracy.

Title: Slysh haloes: the waste heat of cold computing as a submillimetre technosignature
Summary: Proposes "Slysh haloes" -- cold, submillimetre-emitting partial Dyson swarms built by computation-dominated civilizations dissipating waste heat near the cosmic microwave background temperature -- and outlines an archival far-infrared/submillimetre search strategy, favoring M dwarfs as targets.

Title: Identifying Casual SETI Transmissions and Ultra-Faint RFI with Cumulant Imaging
Summary: Introduces a cumulant-imaging technique that reframes radio imaging in terms of higher-order statistical moments, suppressing natural astrophysical noise to reveal faint modulated SETI signals and RFI undetectable with standard methods.

Title: Energy deposition in planetary and exoplanetary atmospheres induced by cosmic rays
Summary: Models how galactic cosmic rays and stellar energetic particles deposit energy in planetary atmospheres using the CosmicTransmutation code, finding that a planet's magnetic field strongly modulates the relative flux of the two particle sources and that resulting atmospheric penetration depths are shallower than earlier simpler models suggested, for both an Earth-like planet and the exoplanet K2-18b.

Title: The Science Potential of Characterizing Gas Giant Exoplanets with HWO
Summary: Uses the EXOSIMS direct-imaging simulator to show the Habitable Worlds Observatory could detect broadband reflected light and near-IR spectral features (water, methane, ammonia) from nearby gas giants, plus rotational light-curve variability and even eclipses or oxygen biosignatures from large exomoons around ExEP target stars.

Title: Silencing the stellar glare with kernel-nulling and active phase control on photonic chips
Summary: Reports the first lab tests of a four-beam kernel-nulling interferometer built from a single photonic-chip multimode-interferometer coupler with active phase control, demonstrating ABCD fringe-tracking and characterizing its starlight-suppression contrast limits for future exoplanet biosignature imaging.

Title: High-CO2 Climates and Observables in the Outer Habitable Zone
Summary: Uses a 3D Generic Planetary Climate Model to simulate outer habitable zone planets with high CO2 and their spectra, showing 3D models with CO2 condensation are needed to predict habitability and distinguish habitable from non-habitable worlds with direct-imaging and transmission/emission spectroscopy.

Title: Towards a GPU-Accelerated Real-Time Imaging Pipeline for SETI at the Allen Telescope Array
Summary: Develops and tests a GPU-accelerated interferometric imaging and image-domain dispersion-measure search pipeline for Allen Telescope Array visibilities, recovering an injected dispersed pulse at the correct DM and processing each integration faster than real time within the CyberEther framework.

Title: Opportunity Lost in Searching for Technosignatures
Summary: Quantifies how growing satellite RFI occupancy, using orbital data and ~10,000 archival MWA observations, shrinks the volume available for unambiguous radio technosignature searches from Earth, and argues for protecting radio-quiet sites like the lunar farside.

Title: The Robots are Coming: Artificial Intelligence Searching for Extraterrestrial Intelligence
Summary: Reviews how Breakthrough Listen is applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to scale up technosignature searches across radio, optical and alert data streams, including with the Vera C. Rubin Observatory.

Title: LoFreq-SETI: A Low-Frequency Technosignature Search Pipeline for the LWA Swarm
Summary: Presents a narrowband technosignature search pipeline based on the Breakthrough Listen Interesting Signal Search algorithm for low-frequency (<100 MHz) LWA data, demonstrated on fast radio burst observations ahead of a campaign targeting exoplanet systems.
